# Excedr

> Excedr is a scientific equipment leasing company enabling biotech and life science startups to access premium lab equipment without large capital expenditures.

Excedr provides flexible equipment leasing and financing solutions across multiple laboratory domains, from analytical instruments to clinical equipment. The platform partners with leading manufacturers like MilliporeSigma and Danaher to offer exclusive discounts and streamlined procurement for early-stage life sciences companies.

## Key Topics

- Lab equipment financing

## Equipment Leasing Solutions

- [Equipment Leasing Solutions](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions): Excedr's equipment leasing solutions hub across all categories
- [Analytical Instrument Leasing & Financing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/analytical-instruments): Leasing for mass spectrometers, particle analyzers, calorimeters
- [Biotech & Life Sciences Equipment Leasing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/biotech-life-sciences): Biotech equipment leasing: 3D bioprinters, chambers, bioanalyzers
- [Chromatography Equipment Leasing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/chromatography): Chromatography leasing: FPLC, gas, ion exchange, liquid systems
- [Clinical Laboratory Equipment Leasing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/clinical-equipment): Clinical lab equipment: IHC stainers, blood bank, chemistry analyzers
- [General Lab Equipment Leasing & Financing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/general-lab-equipment): General lab equipment: autoclaves, liquid handlers, bioreactors
- [Lab Safety Equipment Leasing & Financing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/lab-safety-equipment): Safety equipment leasing: biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, BSL compliance
- [Lab Microscope Leasing & Financing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/microscopes): Microscope leasing: optical, electron, confocal, fluorescence systems
- [Spectroscopy Leasing & Financing](https://www.excedr.com/equipment-leasing-solutions/spectroscopy): Spectrometer leasing from PerkinElmer, Agilent, Thermo Fisher
